name: multi_vstar_bench
description: A benchmark that evaluates language models' performance on the VSTAR-style reasoning tasks across multiple languages, measuring multi-lingual reasoning, commonsense and chain-of-thought style problem solving. It contains prompts and expected answers formatted for automated evaluation of accuracy and consistency across languages. Designed to gauge cross-lingual generalization of reasoning capabilities.
reputation: A small, specialized benchmark with limited but growing use for multilingual reasoning evaluation.
